scope: minimum executable N5a CPU admission bootstrap; not whole T01/pilot
references: docs/discovery/09_文档权威与多Agent开发协作规范.md
docs/discovery/11_测试验收与问题定位规范.md
requirements: consume existing project-tasks.json and approved immutable task card, no second task registry
trusted approval commit/card hash separate from candidate; candidate cannot widen its own write/tests/review policy
real Git worktree/branch/head/baseline/dependency/diff including staged unstaged untracked and rename ends
canonical file case/path containment plus overlapping writer/root lock/shared-file and resource collisions
only declared consumer subset needs exact dependency commit/source hash/non-author review; unrelated K/M1 pending does not block CPU task
execute trusted declared node tests, verify named required cases really ran successfully; reject nonzero/zero/missing/skip/todo/cancel/incomplete reports
explicit compatibility failure negative and independent-CPU ready positive
fail closed CLI with sanitized errors, no shell execution of arbitrary candidate commands
CI local pure tests on Windows, explicit dev/codex/**/PR/manual trigger, no official release or package/runtime/model download
expectedRed: tests expose absent admission behavior, then each actual rejection and positive behavior; no source-text assertions
expectedGreen: actual negative fixtures rejected and independent ready CPU example admitted; non-author review before consumer use
review: fresh non-author spec/quality, exact source/log hashes and current Git evidence
notGranted: parallel implementation admission, dev integration or all T01 acceptance
